note: Nantucket County is coextensive with the Town of Nantucket, which zones the island. The town publishes its zoning districts only as PDF zoning maps (GIS-Maps page) and through the MapGeo web viewer (nantucketma.mapgeo.io), which has no public ArcGIS REST or downloadable zoning layer. The MassGIS-linked town viewer item (f9ca9e33f9a84eadae0594e62a8fb6b0) points to that same MapGeo site. ArcGIS searches for Nantucket zoning found only a county boundary layer (services1.arcgis.com/VLhaRwzp3uCQMr7y/.../Nantucket_County/FeatureServer), not zoning. No queryable zoning polygon service was found.
